brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Single-cell build: piece:0,0,0;full with hex-bin-full drop-in tray (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full) provides 80mm deep storage volume. Six edge caps close side openings and top cover:0,0,0;full;top closes the top, forming a lidded box. Verified capOpenFaces and lockJoints, check_build clear.

requirements.requirement: Lid is held shut with magnets
requirements.evidence: Top cover magnets enabled via setCoverMagnets on:true (confirmed by toggling off/on). BOM lists 6x Neodymium disc magnet Ø5×1mm in cover + 6x Steel BB 4.5mm in bin rim for magnetic closure; cover snaps to bin and magnets hold it shut.

finish.summary: Built a compact single-hex storage box: full hex base with full-depth bin insert and full top cover as lid. Lid magnets are active (6 magnets + 6 BBs in BOM) so the cover snaps shut and is held by magnets. Side faces capped and joints locked, check_build clear.
